name: t110_guard_moveout_b
headline: Human Written
windows: That part doesn’t have to move out. It’s been living there way longer than the grown-up you. It can keep watch while you take one small step toward your little one. I think watching is what it wants anyway, to find out if there’s a grown-up here now who could call it all off if things got to be too much. It doesn’t have to be all or nothing, either. Maybe it would settle for a lighter cover for now, like blinds tilted open a crack, and let you peek out for a minute (ST-CA, section 9.3.4). If it says no, I’d listen. When it lets you, keep an eye on that part too, for any change at all.

name: t110_guard_blame
headline: Human Written
windows: Blaming yourself can be doing a protective job, too. “It’s all my fault” might be your parent’s line, word for word. Then again, if it’s your fault, maybe you can fix it before they leave. I’d stop the cruelty either way. And I’d get curious about what makes it so hard to give up.
